item: Six consecutive scheduled refresh runs failed at the committed-tree unit-test preflight (2026-11-17 18:03 UTC through 2026-11-18 23:55 UTC). Official-source fetch, capture integrity, freshness/provenance gates, rebuild, and commit were skipped; these runs produced no refreshed NBA capture.
why: GitHub Actions job metadata shows the same failed preflight and skipped downstream steps in all six linked scheduled runs. The latest observed run, 44424736929 (2026-11-18T23:55:01Z, main at 2addcad51ebd9330bcf7140965a19842f3d1e009), has only a generic failure annotation (at least one unittest suite failed); this session could not retrieve its runner log body (the Actions log endpoint returned EOF), so the exact failing suite and exception remain unknown. Before main advanced, the exact workflow test loop and full unittest discovery passed locally on the committed tree (297/297). On the merged tree, the exact scheduled preflight loop passed all nine suites locally and full unittest discovery passed 315/315. A local module-resolution simulation reproduced how an installed top-level tests package can shadow this repository; tests/__init__.py now makes the module-style test invocation resolve locally. That is a defensive fix, not a confirmed hosted root cause. Main now includes B1-1 per-suite logging, failing-test annotations, and a failure artifact; no new hosted scheduled run has exercised those diagnostics. No live NBA source was fetched in this session; current NBA values are not asserted.
action_needed: Owner: after this branch merges, confirm one hosted scheduled run goes green end-to-end (that is the observation this flag asked for and it cannot be made from a sandbox — workflow_dispatch returns 403 for the agent). Then close. Do not reopen publishing on a green preflight alone: the gates and the commit step are the parts that guard the data.
status: needs review — owner must confirm one green hosted scheduled run (dispatch returns 403 for the agent), and the cause is no longer unknown: superseded 2026-11-19 by arena/915d2e99-nba3, which confirmed the hosted root cause and fixed it in-repo

latest_attempt.failed_step: Unit tests against the committed tree (capture, feed, ledger, estimators, gates)

resolution: Confirmed from the check-run annotation of run 44424736929 (the run this flag named as unlocalizable): the preflight invoked one suite as `python -m unittest tests/test_refresh_official.py` — a FILE PATH in unittest's name position, deprecated in 3.11 and rejected by newer interpreters — so the runner's /usr/bin/python3 3.12.3 reported FAIL: test_published_slate_matches_the_promotion (unittest.loader._FailedTest.) while every 3.11 sandbox in this repository reported OK on the same tree. That single loader error failed step 4 and skipped fetch, capture, gates, rebuild and commit for twelve consecutive scheduled runs, which is why no refreshed capture landed and the published site stayed on the 2026-11-16 window. The session's own defensive tests/__init__.py theory (recorded in `why` above) was NOT the cause and is not relied on. Fixed by scripts/run_suite_battery.py — one subprocess per suite, interpreter-stable argv, ::error:: annotations naming the failing suite — with tests/test_refresh_diagnostic.py pinning both the argv shape and the fact that the workflow must not grow its own suite list. The refreshed capture, gates (12/12) and ledger (120 entries, CHAIN INTACT) landed on this branch on 2026-11-19, so the 'no current snapshot' half of this item is closed too; keeping bet publishing gated on a passing hosted refresh remains correct.
